"""Bounded CLEVRER public-video-only CPU evidence driver."""
import hashlib
import json
import math
import platform
import shutil
import stat
import subprocess
import tempfile
import time
import zipfile
from collections import Counter
from datetime import UTC, datetime
from fractions import Fraction
from pathlib import Path, PurePosixPath

BASE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
CONFIG = BASE / "clevrer-assets.json"
LIMIT = 128 * 1024**2
SOURCE_ROOT = Path("/root/autodl-tmp/lite-omnijev/source-audit/clevrer-official/files")


def sha(path):
    digest = hashlib.sha256()
    with Path(path).open("rb") as stream:
        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024**2), b""):
            digest.update(block)
    return digest.hexdigest()


started = time.monotonic()
config = json.loads(CONFIG.read_text())
report = {
    "schema_version": 1,
    "started_utc": datetime.now(UTC).isoformat(),
    "code_base_revision": "6d6c221",
    "driver_sha256": sha(__file__),
    "config_snapshot_sha256": sha(CONFIG),
    "python": platform.python_version(),
    "platform": platform.platform(),
    "ffmpeg_version": subprocess.check_output(["ffmpeg", "-version"], text=True).splitlines()[0],
    "ffprobe_version": subprocess.check_output(["ffprobe", "-version"], text=True).splitlines()[0],
    "cpu_max": Path("/sys/fs/cgroup/cpu.max").read_text().strip(),
    "memory_max": Path("/sys/fs/cgroup/memory.max").read_text().strip(),
    "heavy_lock": "/tmp/omnijev-cpu-heavy.lock",
    "ffmpeg_threads": 1,
    "temporary_disk_limit_bytes": LIMIT,
    "maximum_simultaneous_extracted_files": 1,
    "maximum_actual_temporary_video_bytes": 0,
    "selection": "For each split, lexicographically sort all MP4 member names; select indices 0, count//2, count-1.",
    "annotations_questions_hidden_or_sealed_data_read": False,
    "gpu_used": False,
    "model_loaded": False,
    "new_paid_actions": False,
    "existing_cloud_cost": "not_measured",
    "whole_archive_sha_or_crc_recomputed_this_run": False,
    "archive_sha_crc_basis": "Previously verified local SHA256 and full CRC from immutable copied configs/clevrer-assets.json; no upstream SHA256 published.",
    "full_corpus_decodability_verified": False,
    "decoded_pixel_finiteness_checked": False,
    "splits": [],
    "samples": [],
    "exit_code": None,
}
try:
    for split in ("train", "validation", "test"):
        relative = f"videos/{split}/video_{split}.zip"
        source = next(item for item in config["files"] if item["relative_path"] == relative)
        archive_path = Path(source["remote_path"])
        assert archive_path == SOURCE_ROOT / relative and source["zip_crc_check"] == "pass"
        before = archive_path.stat()
        assert stat.S_ISREG(archive_path.lstat().st_mode) and before.st_size == source["expected_bytes"]
        with zipfile.ZipFile(archive_path, "r") as archive:
            members = {}
            expanded = 0
            for entry in archive.infolist():
                name = entry.filename.rstrip("/")
                path = PurePosixPath(name)
                mode = stat.S_IFMT(entry.external_attr >> 16)
                if (not name or path.is_absolute() or ".." in path.parts or "\\" in name
                    or ":" in name or "\x00" in entry.orig_filename or str(path) != name
                    or name in members or mode not in (0, stat.S_IFREG, stat.S_IFDIR)
                    or entry.flag_bits & 1 or entry.file_size > LIMIT):
                    raise ValueError("unsafe_or_oversized_zip_member")
                if mode == stat.S_IFDIR and not entry.is_dir():
                    raise ValueError("zip_directory_mode_mismatch")
                expanded += entry.file_size
                if expanded > 32 * 1024**3 or len(members) >= 20000:
                    raise ValueError("archive_metadata_limit")
                members[name] = entry
            videos = sorted(entry for entry in members if entry.endswith(".mp4"))
            assert len(videos) >= 3
            indices = [0, len(videos) // 2, len(videos) - 1]
            item = {"split": split, "source_url": source["source_url"],
                    "archive_path": str(archive_path), "archive_bytes": before.st_size,
                    "archive_sha256_from_verified_manifest": source["local_sha256"],
                    "safe_member_metadata_verified": True, "member_count": len(members),
                    "video_member_count": len(videos), "expanded_bytes_declared": expanded,
                    "selected_indices": indices, "selected_members": [videos[i] for i in indices]}
            report["splits"].append(item)
            for index in indices:
                member = videos[index]
                entry = members[member]
                with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="clevrer-cpu-tmp-", dir=BASE) as directory:
                    media = Path(directory) / "sample.mp4"
                    with archive.open(entry) as stream, media.open("xb") as target:
                        copied = 0
                        for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024**2), b""):
                            copied += len(block)
                            if copied > LIMIT or copied > entry.file_size:
                                raise ValueError("selected_member_expansion_limit")
                            target.write(block)
                    assert copied == entry.file_size == media.stat().st_size
                    report["maximum_actual_temporary_video_bytes"] = max(
                        report["maximum_actual_temporary_video_bytes"], copied)
                    probe = subprocess.run(["ffprobe", "-v", "error", "-show_streams",
                                            "-show_format", "-of", "json", str(media)],
                                           capture_output=True, text=True, check=True, timeout=30)
                    metadata = json.loads(probe.stdout)
                    video = next(s for s in metadata["streams"] if s["codec_type"] == "video")
                    fps = float(Fraction(video["avg_frame_rate"]))
                    duration = float(video.get("duration", metadata["format"]["duration"]))
                    assert math.isfinite(fps) and fps > 0 and math.isfinite(duration) and duration > 0
                    assert video["width"] > 0 and video["height"] > 0
                    command = ["ffmpeg", "-nostdin", "-v", "error", "-xerror", "-threads", "1",
                               "-filter_threads", "1", "-i", str(media), "-map", "0:v:0",
                               "-an", "-threads", "1", "-progress", "pipe:1", "-nostats", "-f", "null", "-"]
                    decoded = subprocess.run(command, capture_output=True, text=True,
                                             check=True, timeout=120)
                    progress = dict(line.split("=", 1) for line in decoded.stdout.splitlines() if "=" in line)
                    frames = int(progress["frame"])
                    assert progress["progress"] == "end" and frames > 0
                    declared_frames = video.get("nb_frames")
                    if declared_frames and declared_frames != "N/A":
                        assert frames == int(declared_frames)
                    report["samples"].append({"split": split, "member": member,
                        "selected_sorted_index": index, "bytes": copied, "sha256": sha(media),
                        "zip_crc32": f"{entry.CRC:08x}", "selected_member_crc_verified": True,
                        "codec": video.get("codec_name"), "pixel_format": video.get("pix_fmt"),
                        "width": video["width"], "height": video["height"], "fps": fps,
                        "duration_seconds": duration, "declared_frames": declared_frames,
                        "decoded_frames": frames, "finite_positive_metadata_verified": True,
                        "full_video_stream_through_eof": True, "ffprobe_exit_code": probe.returncode,
                        "ffmpeg_exit_code": decoded.returncode, "ffmpeg_progress_end": True,
                        "ffmpeg_stderr": decoded.stderr[:1000]})
                assert not media.exists()
        after = archive_path.stat()
        assert (before.st_size, before.st_mtime_ns, before.st_ino) == (after.st_size, after.st_mtime_ns, after.st_ino)
        item["source_size_mtime_inode_unchanged"] = True
        print(split, "three representative full-stream decodes passed", flush=True)
    assert len(report["samples"]) == 9 and not list(BASE.glob("clevrer-cpu-tmp-*"))
    samples = report["samples"]
    report["aggregate"] = {"sample_count": len(samples),
        "scanned_public_video_member_count": sum(s["video_member_count"] for s in report["splits"]),
        "decoded_frame_sum": sum(s["decoded_frames"] for s in samples),
        "duration_seconds_sum": sum(s["duration_seconds"] for s in samples),
        "dimensions": dict(Counter(f"{s['width']}x{s['height']}" for s in samples)),
        "fps": dict(Counter(str(s["fps"]) for s in samples)),
        "codecs": dict(Counter(s["codec"] for s in samples)),
        "pixel_formats": dict(Counter(s["pixel_format"] for s in samples)),
        "all_selected_decoder_exits_zero": all(s["ffmpeg_exit_code"] == 0 for s in samples)}
    report["exit_code"] = 0
except Exception as error:
    report["exit_code"] = 1
    report["error"] = {"type": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error)[:500]}
    raise
finally:
    report["temporary_extraction_cleanup_verified"] = not list(BASE.glob("clevrer-cpu-tmp-*"))
    report["completed_utc"] = datetime.now(UTC).isoformat()
    report["elapsed_seconds"] = round(time.monotonic() - started, 3)
    (BASE / "result.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps(report, indent=2), flush=True)
